commands:
set -euo pipefail

echo "=== CLONE CONVERRA REPOSITORY ==="
if [ ! -d /opt/groq-chat/.git ]; then
    if [ -e /opt/groq-chat ]; then
        echo "ERROR: /opt/groq-chat exists but is not a Git repository."
        exit 1
    fi
    sudo git clone https://github.com/Geetha-1997/converra.git /opt/groq-chat
else
    echo "Git repository already exists; preserving current checkout."
fi

cd /opt/groq-chat

echo "=== VERIFY PROJECT FILES ==="
test -f backend/server.js
test -f backend/package.json
test -f frontend/index.html

echo "=== INSTALL BACKEND DEPENDENCIES ==="
cd /opt/groq-chat/backend
sudo npm install --omit=dev

echo "=== RETRIEVE GROQ KEY SECURELY ==="
KEY=$(aws ssm get-parameter \
    --name groq-chat \
    --region ap-south-1 \
    --with-decryption \
    --query Parameter.Value \
    --output text)

test -n "$KEY"
test "$KEY" != "None"

sudo install -d -m 700 /etc/converra
umask 077
printf 'PORT=3000\nGROQ_API_KEY=%s\nGROQ_MODEL=llama-3.3-70b-versatile\n' "$KEY" | sudo tee /etc/converra/groqchat.env >/dev/null
sudo chmod 600 /etc/converra/groqchat.env
unset KEY

echo "=== SET UP SYSTEMD SERVICE ==="
NODE_BIN=$(command -v node)

sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/groqchat.service >/dev/null <<EOF
[Unit]
Description=Converra Node.js Backend
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/opt/groq-chat/backend
EnvironmentFile=/etc/converra/groqchat.env
ExecStart=$NODE_BIN server.js
Restart=always
RestartSec=5

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF

echo "=== CONFIGURE NGINX ==="
sudo tee /etc/nginx/conf.d/groqchat.conf >/dev/null <<'EOF'
server {
    listen 80 default_server;
    server_name _;

    root /opt/groq-chat/frontend;
    index index.html;

    location /api/ {
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:3000;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_read_timeout 90s;
    }

    location /health {
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:3000;
    }

    location / {
        try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html;
    }
}
EOF

sudo chmod -R a+rX /opt/groq-chat

echo "=== VALIDATE AND START SERVICES ==="
sudo nginx -t
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable --now groqchat
sudo systemctl enable --now nginx

echo "=== LOCAL HEALTH CHECKS ==="
sleep 3
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1/health
echo
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1/api/models
echo

echo "=== SERVICE STATUS ==="
sudo systemctl is-active groqchat
sudo systemctl is-active nginx

echo "DEPLOYMENT COMPLETED"
